questions.stem: A study group asks what condition produces electromagnetic radiation. Which is correct?

questions.stem: An X-ray tube operates at 50 kV. What is the cutoff wavelength in nm? Use hc = 1240 eV nm.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.stem: Explain how changing electric and magnetic fields sustain an electromagnetic wave.

answer.exemplar: A changing electric field generates a magnetic field via Ampere-Maxwell law, and a changing magnetic field generates an electric field via Faraday law. This mutual regeneration lets the disturbance propagate without a medium.

questions.explanation: Mutual induction via Maxwell's equations sustains the wave in vacuum.
questions.hint: Changing E makes B, changing B makes E.
